review:
A funky vampire and his bat sidekick on six reels with 3,600 ways and tumbles. Marked symbols on reels three and four turn wild for the next tumble if they win.

The headline feature is a doubling multiplier: each tumble in a row doubles it, up to 1,024x, resetting when the tumbles stop. Three scatters give 12 free spins with the multiplier starting at 8x or more. Escalates fast – but most sequences stop after one or two tumbles. Up to 5,000x, 96% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
